shortDescription: Gather IBM Storage Protect BA Client facts

options.name: password
options.description: Password for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_PASSWORD)

options.name: q_backup
options.description: Whether to gather backup information and statistics.

options.name: q_inclexcl
options.description: Whether to gather include/exclude list information.

options.name: q_options
options.description: Whether to gather client options from dsm.opt and dsm.sys.

options.name: q_schedule
options.description: Whether to gather schedule information from the server.

options.name: q_session
options.description: Whether to gather current session information.

options.name: q_systeminfo
options.description: Whether to gather system information (OS, hostname, etc.).

options.name: q_version
options.description: Whether to gather BA Client version information.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the IBM Storage Protect host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: server_name
options.description: SERVERNAME your IBM Storage Protect instance as specified in the dsm.sys. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_SERVERNAME) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(local) will be used

options.name: username
options.description: Username for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_USERNAME)
